title: Refund already credited
description: The merchant's refund is already on the account; the agent rejects instead of paying twice.

evidence.summary: 1 matching charge(s) of 410.0 EUR at AirFly on: 2026-08-01

clauses.title: Merchant refund not processed
clauses.text: If a merchant promised a refund that has not appeared on the account, and no matching credit from that merchant exists in the ledger, the original transaction amount is refunded as a provisional credit.

clauses.title: Refund already credited
clauses.text: If the ledger already shows a credit from the merchant matching the refund, the dispute is rejected and the customer is shown the date the credit was posted.

clauses.title: Scope of card disputes
clauses.text: This policy covers disputes about card transactions on Northwind consumer accounts: duplicate charges, goods or services not received, unauthorized transactions, incorrect amounts and refunds not processed by the merchant. A dispute must reference a specific transaction on the customer's account.

clauses.title: Filing window
clauses.text: A dispute must be raised within 90 days of the transaction date. Disputes raised after 90 days are rejected, except for unauthorized transactions on accounts flagged for fraud review, which are escalated.

clauses.title: Transaction must be identified
clauses.text: If no transaction on the customer's account matches the merchant, amount or date described, the agent must ask the customer for the transaction date, merchant name and amount before any decision is made.

clauses.title: Human review threshold
clauses.text: Any refund above 300 EUR, any case where the agent's confidence is low, and any case involving suspected fraud must be reviewed by a human dispute officer before the customer is notified.

args.query: refund_not_processed AirFly promised me a refund for my cancelled 410.00 EUR flight booked on 1 August, but it never arrived.

tool_calls.observation: POL-REF-01: Merchant refund not processed; POL-REF-02: Refund already credited

update.rationale: The ledger already shows a credit from AirFly matching the refund amount, so this is a refund already credited case rather than a refund not processed case. Under policy, such disputes are rejected and the customer should be shown the credit date.

update.response_draft: I’m sorry for the frustration. We reviewed your AirFly refund request for 410.00 EUR from 2026-08-01, and the ledger shows a credit from AirFly for the same amount. Because the merchant’s credit is already on your account, this is shown on your statement and is not treated as a refund not processed case. (Policy reference: POL-REF-02)
